verdict.line: You lose if he lands Q into W before you have mana to spam Parrrley; you win once Essence Reaver lets you out-poke his tankiness for the rest of the game.

brief.thesis: K'Sante owns the lane and solo-kill matchup because his kit is built to force a melee fight you don't want — Q (Ntofo Strikes) stacks into a pull, W (Path Maker) stuns through the stack. Gangplank's actual win condition is refusing that fight entirely: Q (Parrrley) at 625 range outranges both his Q (450) and E (525), so the matchup is won by how little melee contact you allow, not by trading autos.

theirWindow.when: when his W is off cooldown
theirWindow.what: Path Maker's charge-up telegraphs the stun dash — if you see him start charging, you're about to get engaged. Back off the moment he starts channeling rather than after he moves.

yourWindow.when: when his E is off cooldown
yourWindow.what: With Footwork down he has no dash or shield to close the range gap or soak your poison. Walk up, land Parrrley, and walk back out of his Q range before he can punish.

powerCurve.note: Q-stack pull into W stun threatens early kill
Q range advantage starts equalizing trades
R adds zone pressure he can't answer
Essence Reaver sustain outpokes his tankiness

start.why: 73.5% pick at 51.3% win over 1777 games — the extra AD boosts early Parrrley damage and the sustain lets you hold the poke pattern through his Q harass instead of backing off the wave.

boots.why: 36% pick at 51.8% win — his damage is almost entirely auto-attack and Ntofo Strikes procs, so flat physical reduction blunts the chip damage he's winning the lane with.

core.why: Mana sustain lets you actually spam Q at 5s cooldown all lane instead of running dry after two or three pokes.
Highest-win path in the data (58.8% over 221 games) — the execute threshold turns your poke into real kill pressure once he's chunked.
Armor penetration is what actually lets poison and Parrrley damage through his base tank stats.

situational.when: his e (footwork) shield is eating most of your poke damage
he's landing his r (all out) knockback and you need a lifeline through the follow-up burst
you're ahead and he has no more armor to stack against

runes.keystoneWhy: The delayed burn stacks with your poison passive on every Parrrley poke, converting ranged harass into real damage over time without you ever needing to stand in his Q/W range to deliver it.

summoners.why: 78.3% pick at 50.7% win. Ignite punishes the poke trades you're already winning and denies his Footwork shield healing back the damage; Flash is your answer to the W stun and the R knockback-through-wall combo.

playing.title: Take E at level 1
playing.detail: The data's skill order opens with E (Raise Morale), not Q — use the movement speed to control spacing and dodge his early all-in rather than forcing poke damage you can't back up yet.

playing.title: Count his Q stacks
playing.detail: At 2 stacks of Ntofo Strikes he fires a shockwave that pulls you in. Never stand in a line with him once he's at 1 stack with minions nearby.

playing.title: Trade only when his W is down
playing.detail: Path Maker's charge-up is his only hard engage tool. Back off the instant you see the charge animation start — don't wait for the dash.

playing.title: Out-range, don't out-melee
playing.detail: Parrrley's 625 range beats both his Q (450) and E (525). Poke and retreat; standing in auto-attack range just lets his stacking Q catch up to you.

playing.title: Hold W for his ultimate
playing.detail: Remove Scurvy clears CC — save it for the knockback from his R (All Out) so you're not stuck eating his transformed-state damage for free.

playing.title: Itemize against his shield
playing.detail: Serpent's Fang directly answers Footwork's shield, which is otherwise absorbing a large share of your poke damage output.

playing.title: Use R to punish his resets
playing.detail: Cannon Barrage's 20000 range means you can zone his recalls or follow-up plays anywhere on the map, not just in lane — its long cooldown (120/115/110/120/120s) means every cast should target a real window, not just chip damage.

brief.patchCaveat: Build paths, runes, summoners, and win rates above come from measured games on the current patch (16.19.1); the mechanical reasoning — why the trades favor him early and you late — is my own read of the kit, not something OP.GG reports directly.
